logic.note: pure logic: deny-by-default tenant isolation, rotate-changes-hash, revoke, verify-by-hash, DSAR erasure, raw-key-never-stored

integration.note: HTTP API boundary: server.mjs route handlers + bearer auth chokepoint; issue returns raw once, list is metadata-only

component.note: key-lifecycle component: rotate mints new material, changes the stored hash, invalidates the old credential, writes a rotate audit row; revoked key -> 409

e2e.note: cross-tenant isolation end-to-end: tenant B cannot list/get/rotate/revoke tenant A keys (404/403), denied actions leave no audit row
